note: The rows of parked scooters of the Vũng Tàu world (plan 0023, R9a, PT-57). A row stands on the sidewalk of the road "road" near the landmark "near" (or near the point "at", x and z of the game): "count" scooters on the sides of the road, from the nearest point of the road to the landmark. "sidewalk" is the width from the edge of the road to the line of the shop fronts, in meters. "from" and "to" are the hours of the row (0 to 24: all day). The houses and the shops of plan 0009 add the rows in front of each house.

rows.note: Plan 0026, R11: the scooters of the customers of the bars and the hotels of Quang Trung 4 to 26, on the sidewalk of the side of the town (6.5 m, the World survey of Quang Trung). The count and the hours are builder values.
